notes: The second *after* is read as the distributed scope of the one עַל (rule 25) rather than as part of the comparative particle's rendering; giving *as after* whole to כְּ under rule 30 was the competing reading.
*of men* is `added` because both the preposition and the head noun are supplied (rule 33's closing sentence); גֵּו itself is rendered by *midst*.
The assimilated article of כַּגַּנָּב is a real token and takes nothing, the ASV writing *a thief* (rules 12 and 29).
